event_data.context:
Baseline: eventcore-v2.1.0 (fea3e386cce904e9ef9b76cd303926870d04a692). Acceptance scenarios and Gleam tests are listed at https://github.com/10krco/eventcore-gl/blob/main/docs/parity.md#command-runtime-and-in-memory-store.

PR #2 merged the optimistic store and OTP adapter. PR #3 covers ordered replay, participant discovery, atomic command transfer, the retry policy and the shared store contract. The signed runtime revision f68bea6872b35fefbf205f000bb039dea9bf412e passed the 12-test local gate and is in GitHub CI and App review.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the command runtime and in-memory store capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Command runtime and in-memory store
